name: Tikkun Worldwide Charity Inc.
notes: Disaster-relief nonprofit doing food giveaways/deliveries (10,000+ lbs/week per their own posts), but no credible recurring day+time schedule published. Updates only via Facebook/Instagram event posts. CAPOC lists it as a distribution partner without hours.

name: Tustin Presbyterian Church
notes: Church's own mission page confirms a weekly Saturday-morning TPC Food Pantry (volunteers sort Friday, staff Saturday morning), but no specific opening/closing time is published, so it fails the day+time requirement. Would need to call (714) 544-7070 to confirm hours.

name: Bethany Bible Fellowship
notes: Runs a client-choice food pantry (bethanyoc.org / CAPOC partner) but operates by same-day appointment scheduling, not a fixed recurring day+time. No published weekly schedule found.

name: BPSOS Center for Community Advancement
notes: Community center offering a food bank among many services; general office hours Mon-Fri 9 AM-5 PM but no specific recurring food-distribution day+time published. CAPOC partner without listed hours.

name: Iglesia Cristiana Siloe (PCG)
notes: Listed as an OC Food Bank/CAPOC distribution partner at 13612 Hoover St, but no specific recurring day+time schedule found on church site, Facebook, or listings.

name: International Sangha Bhilashu Buddist Nuns Congregation (ISBBNC)
notes: Buddhist nuns congregation (founded 2016) at 8752 Westminster Blvd; CAPOC distribution partner but no published food-distribution day or time found in any source.

name: WCA 'Westminster Christian Assembly'
notes: Listed as CAPOC/OC Food Bank distribution partner at 14642 Bushard St. Church website (wcachurch.org) shows only worship service times, no food pantry schedule. No credible recurring day+time found.
